email: Hi, I noticed I was charged twice for my subscription this month. Can I get a refund?
expected_summary: Customer requests a refund for a duplicate subscription charge.

email: I can't log into my account. It says my password is incorrect.
expected_summary: Customer is unable to log into their account due to an incorrect password.

email: My order hasn't arrived yet and it's been over two weeks.
expected_summary: Customer is inquiring about a delayed order that has not arrived within the expected timeframe.

email: I received a damaged item in my recent order.
expected_summary: Customer reports receiving a damaged item in their recent order and seeks resolution.

email: I want to change the shipping address for my recent order.
expected_summary: Customer requests to update the shipping address for their recent order.

email: Hello, my invoice shows the annual plan at $240, but the checkout page quoted $199. Could you check which amount I should have paid?
expected_summary: Customer asks about a difference between the annual plan price shown on the invoice and the checkout quote.

email: I cancelled my plan last week, but another monthly payment came out today. Please reverse that charge.
expected_summary: Customer requests reversal of a monthly charge made after cancelling their plan.

email: The tax on my receipt looks much higher than the rate for my location. Can someone review the calculation?
expected_summary: Customer asks for a review of the tax amount on their receipt.

email: I paid the renewal invoice by bank transfer yesterday, but it is still marked unpaid in the portal.
expected_summary: Customer reports that a bank transfer payment has not been reflected on the renewal invoice.

email: My plan was downgraded before the new billing cycle, but I was still charged the old, higher rate. Would you adjust the bill?
expected_summary: Customer requests a billing adjustment after being charged the previous plan rate following a downgrade.

email: Can you send me a receipt for the $32.50 payment processed on October 2?
expected_summary: Customer requests a receipt for a payment processed on October 2.

email: I used a gift card at checkout, but the full amount was charged to my credit card as well. The gift card balance is gone too.
expected_summary: Customer reports being charged both the full amount on a credit card and a gift card balance for one purchase.

email: Why does my account have a $7.99 charge labeled 'service adjustment'? I don't recognize it.
expected_summary: Customer asks for an explanation of an unrecognized $7.99 service adjustment charge.

email: Please update the card used for next month's subscription invoice to the new card ending in 1842.
expected_summary: Customer requests to change the payment card for the next subscription invoice.

email: The desktop app closes as soon as I click Export. I have restarted twice and the same thing happens.
expected_summary: Customer reports that the desktop app crashes when they select Export.

email: The search box returns no results for terms that are definitely in my project notes. Searching by exact title works, but not by keyword.
expected_summary: Customer reports that keyword search fails to find text in project notes while exact-title search works.

email: I connected the calendar integration, but events created in your app never appear in my Google Calendar.
expected_summary: Customer reports that events created in the app are not syncing to Google Calendar.

email: Hi, the CSV export has the wrong column order and drops the values in the last two columns. Can you investigate?
expected_summary: Customer reports that CSV exports have an incorrect column order and omit values from the final two columns.

email: I turned off weekly digest emails in notification settings, saved, and signed out. The setting is back on when I return.
expected_summary: Customer reports that the weekly digest preference does not remain disabled after saving and signing back in.

email: On my Android tablet the checkout screen is blank after I tap Continue, although checkout works in the browser on my laptop.
expected_summary: Customer reports that the checkout screen is blank in the Android app but works in a laptop browser.

email: The API started returning 429 responses for requests that are well below our documented rate limit. This began around 9 a.m. today.
expected_summary: Customer reports unexpected API rate-limit responses below the documented limit beginning around 9 a.m.

email: My uploaded audio plays with a crackling sound in the preview, but the original file sounds normal on my computer.
expected_summary: Customer reports that uploaded audio has crackling playback in the app preview despite a normal original file.

email: Could you help? The dashboard graphs stop loading at about 80%, and the rest of the page is usable.
expected_summary: Customer reports that dashboard graphs fail to finish loading while the rest of the page remains usable.

email: After yesterday's update, the keyboard shortcut for inserting a comment no longer works on macOS 15. The menu command still works.
expected_summary: Customer reports that the comment keyboard shortcut stopped working on macOS 15 after an update, though the menu command works.

email: I replaced my phone and can't approve the sign-in prompt because the old device is gone. How do I get back in?
expected_summary: Customer cannot approve a sign-in prompt after replacing their phone and asks how to regain account access.

email: The password reset link says it has expired, but I requested it less than five minutes ago. Please help me reset my password.
expected_summary: Customer reports that a recently requested password reset link is already expired and asks for help resetting their password.

email: I can sign in, but my teammate's workspace has disappeared from the account switcher. I still need access for our project.
expected_summary: Customer can sign in but no longer sees a teammate's workspace in the account switcher and needs access to it.

email: Please remove the former employee, Jordan Lee, from our organization and revoke their access today.
expected_summary: Customer requests removal of a former employee from the organization and revocation of their access.

email: I no longer have access to the email address on my profile, so I can't receive the verification code to change it. What can I do?
expected_summary: Customer cannot change their profile email because they cannot access the current address to receive a verification code.

email: My account says it is locked after too many sign-in attempts. I know my password now, but the lockout hasn't cleared.
expected_summary: Customer remains locked out of their account after too many sign-in attempts despite knowing their password.

email: Could you change the primary contact on our account from me to Priya Shah? She should receive future account notices.
expected_summary: Customer requests to change the account's primary contact to Priya Shah.

email: I accepted the invitation to join our team's organization, but the page says I don't have permission to view it.
expected_summary: Customer accepted an organization invitation but is denied permission to view the organization.

email: Where can I download a copy of the personal information stored in my profile? I am not asking to close the account.
expected_summary: Customer asks how to download the personal information stored in their profile.

email: Do you offer training sessions for nonprofit teams, or is there a guide we can share with new volunteers?
expected_summary: Customer asks whether training sessions or onboarding guides are available for nonprofit teams.

email: The parcel tracking page has shown 'label created' for six days. Is there an updated estimate for when my order will ship?
expected_summary: Customer asks for a shipping estimate because their parcel tracking has not progressed beyond label creation for six days.

email: The carrier says my package was delivered yesterday, but nothing is at my door or mailroom. Could you advise on the next step?
expected_summary: Customer cannot locate an order marked delivered and asks what to do next.

email: I ordered the blue notebook, but the box contained the green one. Can I exchange it?
expected_summary: Customer received a green notebook instead of the blue one ordered and requests an exchange.

email: Before I place an order, could you confirm whether the insulated bottle is dishwasher safe?
expected_summary: Customer asks whether the insulated bottle is safe to wash in a dishwasher before ordering.

email: Our team received only 8 of the 10 printed manuals in order 78124. The packing slip lists all 10.
expected_summary: Customer reports that order 78124 contained eight of the ten manuals listed on the packing slip.

email: I accidentally submitted the same order twice a minute apart. Please stop one of them if it hasn't shipped yet.
expected_summary: Customer asks to cancel one of two duplicate orders if it has not shipped.
